prompt: I'm a concert venue in Washington, D.C. Blink-182 played here on their tour the same year Brazil won their fifth FIFA World Cup. What was my name in 2010?
answer: Brazil won its fifth FIFA World Cup in **2002**. Blink-182 played Washington, D.C.’s **MCI Center** that year, and in **2010** the venue was called the **Verizon Center** (now Capital One Arena).
